model.hospital: Heart of the Rockies Regional Medical Center

requires.label: Uninsured or underinsured
requires.quote: HRRMC will provide financial assistance (charity care) to qualified patients who are uninsured or underinsured and do not have the financial means to pay for hospital services.

requires.label: Unable to pay for services
requires.quote: Charity care write-offs are available to qualified persons receiving (1) emergency or (2) unscheduled, non-elective services and who are unable to pay for those services.

notes: Policy covers emergency or unscheduled non-elective services; unscheduled non-elective services not fully captured by vocabulary.
Pregnant women count as two people for family size determination.
For family units of more than 8 members, add $4,540 for each additional member.
Income calculation includes extensive list of sources and exclusions detailed in policy.
Application requires completed Financial Assistance form with documentation of income, expenses, assets, three months bank statements, W-2s, paycheck stubs, tax returns.
Medically necessary services evaluated on case-by-case basis at HRRMC's discretion.
Services eligible include emergency medical services in ER, non-elective services for life-threatening circumstances, services for conditions leading to adverse change if not promptly treated.
Policy states charity care is not a substitute for personal responsibility; patients expected to cooperate with procedures.
No explicit application deadline, ECA timing, or payment plan terms stated in provided text.
req_unable_to_pay may leave out a condition: Policy requires inability to pay, but also requires being uninsured or underinsured.

rules.label: Sliding Scale Income-Based Discount
rules.quote: Financial assistance will be determined on a sliding scale based on family size and family income.

notes: The policy provides specific dollar income thresholds by family size for each discount percentage (10% to 100%) corresponding to FPL percentages from 200% to 425%. For family units of more than 8 members, add $4,540 for each additional member. Pregnant women count as two people for the purpose of this chart. Income includes all monies received before taxes from all sources with specific exclusions listed. Applicants must complete the Financial Assistance Application with all required documentation of income, expenses, and assets. Charity care is available to qualified patients who are uninsured or underinsured and do not have the financial means to pay for hospital services, receiving emergency or unscheduled, non-elective services, and who do not qualify for federal, state, or local assistance and are unable to establish approved payments or pay balances in full.
sliding_scale_discount may leave out a condition: Policy requires completion of Financial Assistance application with all required documentation.
